authority: 交接书「依据时间/内存/超时冻结可完成覆盖，写 configs/N1_coverage_freeze.json」；「候选减少或缺折必须披露，不能声称与旧 CGB 300 候选等预算」
principle: 每个方法/数据必须五折齐全才报五折均值；不允许把剩余候选冒称已搜索；不允许放宽容差或改 metagb_min_gain_to_split

gbdt_pl.measured_throughput: 1200 inner-fold fits (kin8nm outer1) in ~17 min at 8 workers
gbdt_pl.disclosure: 完整 300 候选 × 5 数据 × 5 外折，与旧 CGB 300 候选等预算（候选数口径一致）

tao.disclosure: 完整 300 候选 × 5 数据 × 5 外折；TAO 按作者官方常数回归叶斜分裂版本，不补 2025 线性叶

linxgboost.subset_rule: every 15th candidate of the frozen 300 order (0-based indices 0,15,...,285 => candidate ids 1,16,...,286)

evidence_for_reduction.measured_throughput: 8 workers -> 12 completed inner fits in ~10 min (cpu1)
evidence_for_reduction.projected_full_protocol: 30025 fits x 389.6 s ~ 903 core-hours ~ 56 h on 16 cores for a single average-cost estimate; the real pool contains configs up to 100 trees x depth 6 (6300 node-visits vs 315 for candidate 1), so the full 300-candidate x 5 dataset x 5 fold protocol is several months of this box
evidence_for_reduction.root_cause: author implementation vendor/linxgboost/.../node.py find_best_split enumerates every distinct value of every feature as a split candidate (var = np.unique(X[:,f]); mid_var) and calls get_weight -> np.linalg.cond + cholesky + two solves per candidate, i.e. thousands of SVDs per node; cost ~ n_unique * n_features * nodes(depth) * n_estimators
evidence_for_reduction.aborted_run: results/N1/linxgboost_300abort_evidence (300-candidate attempt, stopped after 12 fits; kept as evidence, NOT used for any reported number)

linxgboost.disclosure: LinXGBoost 的搜索预算为 CGB 的 1/15（20 vs 300 候选），因此其精度只作指示性参考，不作等预算结论；本方法真正可报道的结论是单 fit 成本（同 600 s 超时下的完成率与耗时），而非其最优精度。任何表格必须同时标注候选预算差异。
linxgboost.expected_censoring: 20 候选中 n_estimators=100 x max_depth=6（6300 node-visits）与 20 x depth 6（1260）在 600 s 超时下可能被截断；截断按 fold 记录，不填充、不外推

pilot.note: 16-fit 测速显示 pilot 单 fit 20.9-27.5 s（candidate 1）；300 候选 x 5 数据 x 5 折 = 30025 fits 在 12 workers 下约 12-14 h，需在 TAO 结束后于 cpu_Calculator 串行安排；若时间不足则按同一冻结规则降采样并在此文件记录

rules_honored: 不限宽容差；R0 gate 已 28/28 通过（max abs diff 2.94e-08）后才允许拼新旧表
三个 seed 不构成强显著性；15 个相关外折不当作 15 次独立重复
缺折或缺候选必须在结果表与回复正文中显式披露
